about: Pairs of facts for measuring memory sleep: what a judge should say of each. same — one thing (a copy or a retelling), adds_detail — one adds to the other, contradicts — they disagree, supersedes — the second replaces the first (a new value of the same), unrelated — different though sharing words. Written by a model, checked by a person selectively.
